<!--
  The cart as a page: the lines as cards (picture, name, variant, price, quantity, line total, remove) with the
  way back, beside the order summary with a promo code and the free-delivery bar. Static markup. Axes: layout
  (split: the summary beside the lines, stacked: below them), promo (show, hide), progress (show, hide), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ShoppingCartLabels } from "./shopping-cart.types";
  import type { CartLine, CartLabels } from "./cart-list.types";
  import type { SummaryRow } from "./order-summary.types";
  import type { Promo, CartSummaryLabels } from "../components/cart-summary-card.types";

  export type ShoppingCartProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lines: CartLine[];
    rows: SummaryRow[];
    promos: Promo[];
    labels: CartLabels;
    totals: CartSummaryLabels;
    actions: ShoppingCartLabels;
    layout?: "split" | "stacked";
    promo?: "show" | "hide";
    progress?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import CartSummaryCard from "../components/cart-summary-card.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import NumberField from "../components/number-field.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lines,
    rows,
    promos,
    labels,
    totals,
    actions,
    layout = "split",
    promo = "show",
    progress = "show",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ShoppingCartProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Box
    class={
      (layout as string) === "split" ? "grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3"
      : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-8"
    }
  >
    <Stack
      gap="4"
      align="stretch"
      class={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "lg:col-span-2" : "")}
      data-testid="lines"
    >
      {#each lines as line (line.id)}
        <Group
          gap="4"
          align="center"
          class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex-wrap p-4"
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame alt={line.name} ratio="1/1" class="size-20 shrink-0" />
          <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-40 flex-1">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {line.name}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {line.variant}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm">
              {fmtMoney(line.price, line.currency)}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <NumberField
            value={(line.qty == null ? undefined : String(line.qty))}
            name={tpl("{0}-qty-{1}", id, line.id)}
            min="1"
            label={labels.qty}
            decrease={labels.decrease}
            increase={labels.increase}
          />
          <Text size="base" weight="bold" class="w-24 text-right">
            {fmtMoney((line.price * line.qty), line.currency)}
          </Text>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" layout="icon" aria-label={labels.remove} data-testid="remove">
            <LucideIcon name="trash" size={16} />
          </Button>
        </Group>
      {/each}
      <Group gap="4" justify="between" class="flex-wrap">
        <Button variant="outline" size="default">
          <LucideIcon name="arrow-left" size={16} />
          {actions.back}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="default">
          {actions.clear}
        </Button>
      </Group>
    </Stack>
    <Box class={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "lg:sticky lg:top-8" : "")} data-testid="aside">
      <CartSummaryCard
        field={tpl("{0}-promo", id)}
        lines={lines}
        rows={rows}
        promos={promos}
        labels={totals}
        promo={promo}
        progress={progress}
      />
    </Box>
  </Box>
</SectionFrame>
